name: Extreme Mission
original_name: エクストリームミッション
source:
Komachi Akane, a reserved girl who entered high school only a week ago, suddenly has three years’ worth of high school savings equivalent to 3 million yen stolen and her parents kidnapped by a mysterious man who uses a crutch for a cane.

The Man with a Crutch threatens Akane, saying, “I have your entire fortune. You will have to follow my orders if you want it back.” The Man with a Crutch orders Akane to Rob a Bank, deal drugs, kidnap, break and enter, and kill—and he wants her to do all of these major crimes on her own!

What is this mysterious man’s objective? And what will Akane’s fate be?

[From Google Play]
translation:
小町茜进入高中才一周，突然被偷走了三年来积攒的、相当于300万日元的存款，父母也被一名拄着拐杖的神秘男人绑架。

拐杖男威胁茜：“你全部的财产都在我手里。想拿回去，就必须听从我的命令。”他命令茜抢银行、贩毒、绑架、破门入室和杀人——而且要求她独自完成所有这些重罪！

这个神秘男人的目的是什么？茜的命运又会如何？

[来源：Google Play]
